title: aidd eval grader library
description: The format of evals/library/graders.json: the graders that more than one live-suite case holds, named by purpose. `claude plugin eval` has no include, so each case keeps its own copy of a shared grader. Each entry lists the cases that hold a copy, and the text of the grader is evals/library/graders/<name>.md. A test fails on a copy that differs from its library file.

graders.description: Each shared grader by name, in sorted order.

uses.description: The cases that hold a copy, each as `suite/case/file-stem`: the suite is plugin or team, and the stem is the file name in the case's graders folder without `.md`.
